causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Some electric dryers use two fuses/ breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Thermal limiter tripped
remedies: Call authorized service person for replacement.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Thermal limiter tripped"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker tripped.
NOTE: Some electric dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: No heat temperature selected
remedies: Select another heat setting
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "No heat temperature selected"

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly.
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly."

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Clothes were not completely clean"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under Static occurs.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Overloading"

causes.label: Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets
remedies: Empty all pockets before laundering clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets"

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Appliances dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust setting to Less Dry or Damp.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Type of load and drying conditions
remedies: Drying time will vary according to the load size, types of fabrics, wetness of clothes and the length and condition of the exhaust system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Type of load and drying conditions"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Controls improperly set"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
NOTE: Some electric dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Underloading"

causes.label: 120-volt operation
remedies: If the dryer is operating on a 120 volt circuit, longer drying times are normal.
The drying on this circuit takes about three times as long as on a 240 volt circuit.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "120-volt operation"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a Less Dry or Damp setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately, or use the Wrinkle Care option.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Overloading"

causes.label: Some fabrics will naturally shrink when washed.
remedies: To avoid shrinkage, follow garment care labels exactly.
Some items may be pressed back into shape after drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Some fabrics will naturally shrink when washed."

causes.label: Others can be safely washed, but will shrink in the dryer.
remedies: If you are concerned about shrinkage in a particular item, do not machine wash or tumble dry it.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Others can be safely washed, but will shrink in the dryer."
